questions.subtopic: Statement of Net Position — Internal Balances
questions.stem: At year-end, a city's General Fund reports a $250,000 receivable from the Water Enterprise Fund for services billed to the utility, and the Water Enterprise Fund reports the corresponding $250,000 payable. The General Fund also reports an $80,000 receivable from the Parks Special Revenue Fund. How should these amounts be presented in the government-wide statement of net position?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both the $250,000 and the $80,000 are eliminated, so no interfund amounts appear anywhere in the statement of net position.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Internal balances of $330,000 are reported as an asset of governmental activities with an offsetting $(330,000) in business-type activities.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Internal balances of $250,000 are reported as an asset of governmental activities and $(250,000) in business-type activities, netting to zero in the primary government total column, while the $80,000 is eliminated.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A $250,000 receivable and an $80,000 receivable are both reported as assets of governmental activities with no offsetting amounts.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires that interfund receivables and payables between funds reported in the SAME column be eliminated in full. The $80,000 between the General Fund and a special revenue fund is entirely within governmental activities, so it disappears. Amounts between governmental funds and enterprise funds cross columns, so the $250,000 residual is presented on a single line captioned 'Internal balances' as a positive $250,000 in governmental activities and a negative $250,000 in business-type activities; the two offset so the primary government total is unaffected. Reporting $330,000 as a cross-column internal balance wrongly treats a purely governmental receivable as crossing columns. Eliminating everything ignores that the two columns must each stand on their own. Reporting both receivables gross in governmental activities double counts resources the government owes itself.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34では、同一の列に表示されるファンド間の債権債務は全額相殺する。一般ファンドと特別収入ファンド間の$80,000はどちらも政府活動の列なので完全に消去される。政府ファンドと企業ファンドの間は列をまたぐため、残額$250,000を「Internal balances（内部残高）」の1行として、政府活動に+$250,000、事業型活動に△$250,000で表示する。両者は相殺されるので基本政府の合計列では影響がない。$330,000を列またぎの内部残高とするのは、政府活動内部だけの債権まで列をまたぐものとして扱う誤り。全額消去すると各列が単独で完結しなくなる。両方を政府活動の資産として総額表示すると、自分自身に対する債権を二重計上することになる。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Net Position — Governmental Activities Computation
questions.stem:
A city's governmental activities column includes the following at December 31:
Cash $1,500,000 | Receivables, net $900,000 | Capital assets, net of accumulated depreciation $12,000,000
Deferred outflows of resources — loss on refunding $200,000
Accounts payable $700,000 | Accrued interest payable $100,000
Bonds payable, due within one year $500,000 | Bonds payable, due in more than one year $6,000,000
Deferred inflows of resources — unavailable revenue $300,000
What amount should the city report as total net position of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: Under GASB 63, net position equals assets plus deferred outflows of resources, less liabilities and deferred inflows of resources. Assets total $14,400,000 ($1,500,000 + $900,000 + $12,000,000); adding the $200,000 deferred outflow gives $14,600,000. Liabilities total $7,300,000 ($700,000 + $100,000 + $500,000 + $6,000,000); adding the $300,000 deferred inflow gives $7,600,000. Net position is $14,600,000 - $7,600,000 = $7,000,000. The $7,100,000 figure ignores the deferred outflow and deferred inflow entirely. The $7,200,000 figure reverses them, adding the deferred inflow to assets and the deferred outflow to liabilities. The $13,000,000 figure omits the $6,000,000 of bonds due in more than one year, which the economic resources measurement focus requires be reported.

questions.subtopic: Measurement Focus and Basis of Accounting
questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes the measurement focus and basis of accounting used in the government-wide statement of net position?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Governmental activities use the modified accrual basis and the current financial resources measurement focus, while business-type activities use the accrual basis.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both governmental activities and business-type activities use the accrual basis of accounting and the economic resources measurement focus.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both columns use the modified accrual basis of accounting and the current financial resources measurement focus.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Governmental activities use the accrual basis, while business-type activities use the cash basis for operating revenues and the accrual basis for expenses.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires a single, consistent measurement framework across the entire government-wide statement of net position. Both the governmental activities column and the business-type activities column apply the economic resources measurement focus and the accrual basis, so all capital assets (including infrastructure) and all long-term liabilities are recognized, and revenues are recognized when earned rather than when measurable and available. The modified accrual basis with the current financial resources focus applies only to the governmental FUND statements, which is precisely why a reconciliation to the government-wide statements is required. No column of the government-wide statements uses a cash basis.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、政府全体の純資産計算書全体で単一の測定枠組みを求める。政府活動の列も事業型活動の列も、経済的資源測定焦点と発生主義を適用するため、インフラを含むすべての資本資産と長期負債が計上され、収益は「測定可能かつ利用可能」ではなく稼得時点で認識される。修正発生主義と流動財務資源測定焦点は政府ファンド財務諸表にのみ適用され、だからこそ政府全体への調整表が必要になる。政府全体の財務諸表に現金主義を使う列は存在しない。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Net Position — Required Format
questions.stem: Which of the following is required in the government-wide statement of net position of a state or local government?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A total column that combines the primary government and its discretely presented component units.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Comparative statements of net position for the current year and the prior year.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Inclusion of fiduciary fund assets and liabilities in the total column for the primary government.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A total column for the primary government that combines governmental activities and business-type activities, presented separately from discretely presented component units.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires the statement of net position to present separate columns for governmental activities and business-type activities plus a total column for the primary government. Discretely presented component units appear to the right of that total in one or more separate columns and are NOT added into the primary government total; a combined total of the primary government and its component units is permitted but never required. Comparative prior-year statements are encouraged but not required; the required year-over-year comparison of condensed data appears in MD&A. Fiduciary activities are excluded from the government-wide statements altogether because those resources cannot be used to support the government's own programs.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、純資産計算書に政府活動と事業型活動の各列、および基本政府の合計列を表示することを求める。区分表示（discrete）の構成単位はその合計列の右側に別列で示し、基本政府の合計には含めない。基本政府と構成単位を合算した列は任意であって必須ではない。前年度比較の財務諸表は推奨にとどまり、年度間比較はMD&Aの要約財務情報で行う。受託（fiduciary）活動は、その資源を自らのプログラムに充当できないため、政府全体の財務諸表から完全に除外される。

questions.stem:
A city is preparing its government-wide statement of net position and has identified the following items:
Property taxes levied in the current year that are legally restricted to financing the following year's budget $400,000
A grant received in advance that carries a time requirement permitting use only in the following year $250,000
Cash collected for recreation services the city has not yet provided $150,000
Loss on an advance refunding of bonds, not yet amortized $300,000
What amount should the city report as total deferred inflows of resources?
questions.explanation: Deferred inflows of resources represent an acquisition of net position applicable to a FUTURE reporting period. Property taxes levied for the next year's budget ($400,000) and a grant subject to a time requirement ($250,000) both meet that definition under GASB 33 and GASB 63, for a total of $650,000. The $150,000 collected for services not yet provided is unearned revenue, which is a LIABILITY, not a deferred inflow, because the city still owes performance. The $300,000 unamortized refunding loss is a deferred OUTFLOW of resources reported on the asset side of the statement. The $800,000 figure improperly adds the unearned revenue, and the $950,000 figure improperly adds the refunding loss to the deferred inflow total.
questions.explanationJa: 繰延流入は、将来の報告期間に帰属する純資産の増加を表す。翌年度予算のために賦課した固定資産税$400,000と、時期要件付き補助金$250,000はいずれもGASB 33・GASB 63の定義に該当し、合計$650,000。未提供サービスに対する受領額$150,000は履行義務が残るため前受収益＝負債であり繰延流入ではない。未償却の借換損失$300,000は資産側に表示する繰延流出である。$800,000は前受収益を、$950,000は借換損失を誤って繰延流入に含めた金額。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Net Position — Balances with Fiduciary Funds
questions.stem: At year-end, a city's General Fund reports a $175,000 receivable from the city's custodial fund. How should this amount be reported in the government-wide statement of net position?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is eliminated, because all balances between funds of the same primary government are removed in the government-wide statements.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is reported on the 'internal balances' line as an asset of governmental activities offset by a negative amount in business-type activities.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It is reported as a receivable of governmental activities from an external party, because fiduciary funds are excluded from the government-wide statements.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is omitted from the face of the statement and disclosed only in the notes, because fiduciary resources are not available to support the government's programs.

questions.explanation: Fiduciary funds, including custodial funds, are reported only in the fund financial statements; they are excluded from the government-wide statements because the resources cannot be used to support the government's own programs. Since the other side of the balance is never presented in the government-wide statements, there is nothing to eliminate against and no column to offset. GASB 34 therefore requires amounts due to and from fiduciary funds to be reported as receivables from and payables to EXTERNAL parties in the government-wide statements. Treating the $175,000 as an internal balance would imply an offsetting negative amount in business-type activities that does not exist, and note-only disclosure would understate the assets of governmental activities.
questions.explanationJa: 受託ファンド（カストディアル・ファンドを含む）はファンド財務諸表にのみ表示され、その資源を政府自身のプログラムに充当できないため政府全体の財務諸表からは除外される。相手方が政府全体の財務諸表に一切現れない以上、相殺する対象も、オフセットすべき列も存在しない。そのためGASB 34は、受託ファンドに対する債権債務を政府全体の財務諸表では「外部者に対する債権・債務」として表示することを求めている。$175,000を内部残高として扱うと、存在しないはずの事業型活動のマイナス額を生むことになり、注記のみの開示では政府活動の資産が過少表示となる。

questions.stem: A city's General Fund uses the purchases method for supplies. Supplies on hand at the beginning of the year were $60,000. During the year the city purchased $500,000 of supplies and consumed $420,000 of supplies. What amount of supplies inventory should be reported as an asset of governmental activities in the government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: The government-wide statements apply the economic resources measurement focus, which requires the consumption method: supplies are an asset until used. Ending inventory is $60,000 + $500,000 - $420,000 = $140,000, and expense for the year is the $420,000 consumed. The General Fund, using the purchases method under the current financial resources focus, reports a $500,000 expenditure and no inventory asset, which is why the conversion adds back the $80,000 increase in inventory ($140,000 - $60,000). The $80,000 figure is only the change in inventory, not the balance. The $60,000 figure is the beginning balance. Reporting zero would apply the purchases method to the government-wide statements, which the economic resources focus does not permit.
questions.explanationJa: 政府全体の財務諸表は経済的資源測定焦点を用いるため、消費法によって貯蔵品は使用するまで資産として計上する。期末残高は$60,000＋$500,000－$420,000＝$140,000、当期費用は消費額$420,000。一般ファンドは流動財務資源測定焦点のもとで購入法を用い、支出$500,000を計上し貯蔵品資産は計上しないため、調整では在庫の増加$80,000（$140,000－$60,000）を加算する。$80,000は残高ではなく増減額。$60,000は期首残高。ゼロとするのは政府全体の財務諸表に購入法を適用する誤りで、経済的資源測定焦点では認められない。

questions.subtopic: Long-Term Liabilities — Due Within One Year
questions.stem:
A city's governmental activities include the following long-term liabilities at year-end:
Bonds payable, total outstanding $10,000,000, of which $800,000 of principal matures during the next fiscal year
Compensated absences liability $900,000, of which $150,000 is expected to be used or paid during the next fiscal year
Net pension liability $2,400,000, none of which is expected to be liquidated with current resources next year
What amount should be reported as 'long-term liabilities — due within one year' in the government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires long-term liabilities to be split between the portion due within one year and the portion due in more than one year. The current portion is $800,000 of bond principal plus the $150,000 of compensated absences expected to be used or paid next year, or $950,000. The remaining $9,200,000 of bonds, $750,000 of compensated absences, and the entire $2,400,000 net pension liability are reported as due in more than one year. The $800,000 figure ignores the compensated absences that will come due. The $1,700,000 figure treats the entire compensated absences balance as current rather than only the portion expected to be used. The $3,350,000 figure adds the full net pension liability, which is not expected to be liquidated next year.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、長期負債を「1年以内に期限到来する部分」と「1年超の部分」に区分して表示することを求める。1年以内の部分は債券元本$800,000と、翌年度に消化・支払が見込まれる有給休暇$150,000の合計$950,000。残りの債券$9,200,000、有給休暇$750,000、および正味年金負債$2,400,000の全額は1年超に区分する。$800,000は有給休暇の当期到来分を無視した金額。$1,700,000は有給休暇の全額を流動扱いした誤り。$3,350,000は翌年度に決済見込みのない正味年金負債まで流動に含めた金額。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Net Program Expense with Indirect Costs
questions.stem:
A city presents its statement of activities with a separate column for indirect expense allocations. For the culture and recreation function it reports the following:
Direct expenses $4,200,000 | Indirect administrative expenses allocated to the function $300,000
Charges for services $700,000 | Operating grants and contributions $500,000 | Capital grants and contributions $1,200,000
The city also earned $100,000 of unrestricted investment income during the year.
What is the net (expense) revenue reported for the culture and recreation function after the indirect expense allocation?
questions.explanation: Net (expense) revenue for a function equals its total expenses less its program revenues. Total expenses are $4,200,000 of direct expenses plus the $300,000 of allocated indirect expenses, or $4,500,000. Program revenues include all three categories: charges for services $700,000, operating grants and contributions $500,000, and capital grants and contributions $1,200,000, totaling $2,400,000. Net expense is $4,500,000 - $2,400,000 = $2,100,000. The $(1,800,000) figure omits the allocated indirect expenses. The $(3,300,000) figure excludes capital grants from program revenues, but GASB 34 includes them. The $(2,000,000) figure subtracts the unrestricted investment income, which is a general revenue reported below the functions and never offsets a program's expense.
questions.explanationJa: 機能別の純費用は、当該機能の総費用からプログラム収益を差し引いて求める。総費用は直接費$4,200,000＋配賦された間接費$300,000＝$4,500,000。プログラム収益は3区分すべてを含み、サービス料$700,000＋事業運営補助金$500,000＋資本補助金$1,200,000＝$2,400,000。純費用は$4,500,000－$2,400,000＝$2,100,000。$(1,800,000)は間接費の配賦を除いた金額。$(3,300,000)は資本補助金をプログラム収益から除いた誤りで、GASB 34では含める。$(2,000,000)は非拘束の投資収益を控除しているが、これは機能欄の下に表示する一般収益であり、個別機能の費用と相殺しない。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — General Revenue Identification
questions.stem: In its government-wide statement of activities, which of the following would a city report as a GENERAL revenue?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An operating grant from the state that is restricted to the city's public health function.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The city's share of a state-levied sales tax, remitted to the city with no restriction on its use.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Parking fines assessed by the municipal court and enforced by the city's police department.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A federal capital grant restricted to construction of a bridge maintained by the public works function.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 defines program revenues as those that derive directly from the program itself or from parties outside the citizenry that reduce the net cost of the function: charges for services, operating grants and contributions, and capital grants and contributions. Everything else is a general revenue. An unrestricted shared sales tax is not tied to any function and therefore is a general revenue; all taxes, including shared taxes without restriction, fall in that category. The restricted state health grant is an operating grant of the public health function, and the federal bridge grant is a capital grant of the public works function. Fines and forfeitures are charges for services reported as program revenue of the function that assesses them, here public safety.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、プログラム収益を「プログラム自体から生じるもの」または「住民以外の第三者から受け取り機能の純コストを減少させるもの」と定義し、サービス料、事業運営補助金・拠出、資本補助金・拠出の3区分とする。それ以外はすべて一般収益となる。使途制限のない分与売上税は特定の機能と結びつかないため一般収益であり、制限のない分与税を含め租税は一般収益に区分される。州の保健向け補助金は公衆衛生機能の事業運営補助金、連邦の橋梁補助金は公共事業機能の資本補助金である。罰金・過料は、それを賦課する機能（ここでは公安）のサービス料としてプログラム収益に計上する。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Special and Extraordinary Items
questions.stem: During the year a city (1) sold its municipal golf course at a $2,500,000 gain; the decision to sell was made by the city council and sales of this kind are unusual for the city, and (2) received a $1,000,000 insurance recovery for damage caused by a tornado, an event that is both unusual in nature and infrequent in occurrence for the city's region and outside management's control. How should these items be reported in the government-wide statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both are reported as special items on a single line immediately after total general revenues.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both are reported as general revenues of governmental activities.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The golf course gain is reported as program revenue of the culture and recreation function and the insurance recovery as an extraordinary item.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The golf course gain is reported as a special item and the insurance recovery as an extraordinary item, each on a separate line below general revenues.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 distinguishes the two by who controls the event. A special item is significant, within management's control, and either unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence; the sale of the golf course was a deliberate council decision and so is a special item. An extraordinary item is both unusual in nature AND infrequent in occurrence and is outside management's control; the tornado recovery meets that test. Both are reported separately in the lower section of the statement of activities, after general revenues and transfers, and are not combined on one line. Reporting the gain as program revenue is wrong because gains on disposal of capital assets are not one of the three program revenue categories, and neither item qualifies as a general revenue.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、事象を経営者が支配できるかどうかで両者を区別する。特別項目（special item）は金額的に重要で、経営者の支配下にあり、かつ異常性または稀少性のいずれかを満たすもので、市議会の判断によるゴルフ場売却はこれに該当する。異常項目（extraordinary item）は異常性と稀少性の両方を満たし、かつ経営者の支配外の事象で、竜巻に係る保険金回収がこれにあたる。いずれも活動計算書の下部、一般収益・振替の後に別々の行で表示し、1行にまとめない。売却益をプログラム収益とするのは、資本資産の処分益がプログラム収益の3区分に含まれないため誤り。また、どちらも一般収益には該当しない。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Change in Net Position Computation
questions.stem:
A city's government-wide statement of activities shows the following for governmental activities:
Total net (expense) revenue for all governmental functions $(18,000,000)
Property taxes $14,000,000 | Unrestricted state aid $3,000,000 | Unrestricted investment earnings $400,000
Special item — gain on sale of unused land $600,000
Transfers to business-type activities $(500,000)
What is the change in net position of governmental activities for the year?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A decrease of $500,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: A decrease of $1,100,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: An increase of $500,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: No change in net position

questions.explanation: The lower section of the statement of activities adds general revenues, special items, and transfers to the total net expense of the functions. General revenues total $17,400,000 ($14,000,000 + $3,000,000 + $400,000). Starting from the $18,000,000 net expense: -$18,000,000 + $17,400,000 + $600,000 special item - $500,000 transfers out = a $500,000 decrease. The $1,100,000 decrease omits the special item, which belongs in this section rather than among the functions. The $500,000 increase treats the transfer to business-type activities as an inflow rather than an outflow. Reporting no change ignores the transfer entirely; transfers between the two columns are not eliminated and must be reported on the face of the statement.
questions.explanationJa: 活動計算書の下部では、機能別純費用の合計に一般収益・特別項目・振替を加減する。一般収益は$14,000,000＋$3,000,000＋$400,000＝$17,400,000。純費用$18,000,000から出発して、△$18,000,000＋$17,400,000＋特別項目$600,000－振替支出$500,000＝△$500,000（純資産の減少）。$1,100,000の減少は特別項目を落としており、特別項目は機能欄ではなくこの区分に表示する。$500,000の増加は事業型活動への振替を支出ではなく収入として扱った誤り。増減なしとするのは振替を無視したもので、2つの列の間の振替は相殺されず本表に表示しなければならない。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Program Revenue Computation
questions.stem:
A city's transportation function received the following during the year:
Passenger fares $1,500,000
Federal grant restricted to the purchase of buses $2,000,000
State grant to subsidize daily operations $600,000
Road segment contributed by a developer, fair value $900,000
Property taxes levied by the city under an ordinance dedicating the proceeds to transportation $1,200,000
What total amount should be reported as program revenues of the transportation function?
questions.explanation: Program revenues comprise charges for services, operating grants and contributions, and capital grants and contributions. Fares are charges for services of $1,500,000; the operating subsidy is an operating grant of $600,000; the bus grant of $2,000,000 and the contributed road of $900,000 are both capital grants and contributions. Total program revenues are $5,000,000. Taxes levied by the reporting government are ALWAYS general revenues even when the enabling ordinance dedicates the proceeds to a specific function, so the $1,200,000 is excluded; the $6,200,000 figure improperly includes it. The $4,100,000 figure omits the contributed road, but a capital contribution from a developer is a capital grant and contribution. The $2,100,000 figure counts only fares and the operating subsidy.
questions.explanationJa: プログラム収益は、サービス料、事業運営補助金・拠出、資本補助金・拠出の3区分からなる。運賃$1,500,000はサービス料、運営補助$600,000は事業運営補助金、バス購入補助$2,000,000と開発業者からの道路現物拠出$900,000はいずれも資本補助金・拠出。合計$5,000,000。報告主体自身が賦課した租税は、条例で特定機能に充当することが定められていても常に一般収益であるため$1,200,000は除外され、$6,200,000はこれを誤って含めた金額。$4,100,000は現物拠出された道路を落としているが、開発業者からの資本拠出は資本補助金・拠出に該当する。$2,100,000は運賃と運営補助だけを集計した金額。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Depreciation on Infrastructure
questions.stem: A city depreciates its road network, which is maintained by the public works function. How should depreciation on those roads be presented in the government-wide statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Allocated to all functions in proportion to each function's direct expenses, because roads benefit every program.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Reported as a single unallocated line item, because infrastructure serves the citizenry as a whole.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Reported as a direct expense of the function, such as public works, that is normally associated with the infrastructure.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Not reported, because infrastructure assets are exempt from depreciation in all circumstances.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires depreciation on capital assets that are clearly identified with a function to be included in that function's direct expenses. Infrastructure such as a road network is normally associated with the public works or transportation function, so its depreciation is charged there rather than spread across all programs. Only depreciation on capital assets that serve essentially all functions, such as a city hall, may be reported as a separate unallocated line or allocated among functions. Infrastructure is depreciated unless the government elects the modified approach and meets its asset management and condition assessment requirements, so treating it as never depreciated is incorrect.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、特定の機能に明確に紐づく資本資産の減価償却費を、その機能の直接費に含めることを求める。道路網のようなインフラは通常、公共事業（または交通）機能に紐づくため、その減価償却費は全プログラムに按分せず当該機能に賦課する。全機能に役立つ資本資産（市庁舎など）の減価償却費に限り、未配賦の独立行として表示するか、機能間に配賦することが認められる。インフラは、政府が修正アプローチを選択し資産管理・状態評価の要件を満たす場合を除き減価償却の対象となるため、一切償却しないという説明は誤り。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Interest on General Long-Term Debt
questions.stem: A city incurred $900,000 of interest during the year on general obligation bonds whose proceeds financed capital projects across several governmental functions. The borrowing is not essential to the creation or continuing existence of any single program. How should the interest be reported in the government-wide statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As a separate line item among the governmental functions, not allocated to the individual functions.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Allocated to each function in proportion to the carrying amount of the capital assets it uses.

choices.label: C
choices.text: As a direct expense of the general government function, because that function administers the debt.

choices.label: D
choices.text: As a reduction of general revenues in the lower section of the statement.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 provides that interest on general long-term liabilities is ordinarily reported as a separate line in the functions section rather than as a direct expense of any function. Interest is charged to a function only in the limited case where the borrowing is essential to the creation or continuing existence of that program, which the facts rule out here. Allocating the interest by capital asset carrying amounts is not permitted, and charging it to general government would misstate that function's net cost by loading it with financing costs of other programs. Interest is an expense of the functions section and is never netted against general revenues, which are presented separately below the functions.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34では、一般長期債務に係る支払利息は原則として機能欄の独立した行として表示し、特定機能の直接費とはしない。利息を機能に賦課するのは、その借入が当該プログラムの創設や存続に不可欠である限定的な場合に限られるが、本問の前提はこれを否定している。資本資産の帳簿価額に応じて配賦する方法は認められておらず、一般管理（general government）機能の直接費とすると、他のプログラムの資金調達コストを負わせてその機能の純コストを歪めることになる。利息は機能欄の費用であり、機能欄の下に別途表示される一般収益と相殺することはない。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Fund Balances to Net Position
questions.stem:
A city reports total governmental fund balances of $4,200,000 at year-end. The following additional information relates to governmental activities:
Capital assets used in governmental activities, net of accumulated depreciation $18,000,000
General obligation bonds payable $9,000,000, plus unamortized bond premium $300,000
Accrued interest payable not recorded in the funds $120,000
Property taxes receivable reported as a deferred inflow in the funds because they are not available $450,000
Net position of an internal service fund that serves governmental departments $700,000
What amount should be reported as net position of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: Start with total governmental fund balances of $4,200,000. Add capital assets of $18,000,000, which the funds do not report. Deduct long-term debt of $9,300,000, including the unamortized premium, since the premium is part of the carrying amount of the liability under the accrual basis. Deduct accrued interest of $120,000. Add back the $450,000 deferred inflow for unavailable taxes, because the availability criterion does not apply under full accrual. Add the internal service fund's $700,000 net position, which is consolidated into governmental activities. The result is $4,200,000 + $18,000,000 - $9,300,000 - $120,000 + $450,000 + $700,000 = $13,930,000. The $13,230,000 figure omits the internal service fund. The $14,230,000 figure ignores the bond premium. The $13,480,000 figure fails to add back the unavailable tax revenue.
questions.explanationJa: 政府ファンド残高合計$4,200,000から出発する。ファンドでは計上されない資本資産$18,000,000を加算する。発生主義では未償却プレミアムも負債の帳簿価額の一部であるため、長期債務は$9,300,000として控除する。未払利息$120,000を控除する。全部発生主義では「利用可能性」の要件が適用されないため、未収固定資産税に係る繰延流入$450,000を戻し入れる。政府活動に統合される内部サービスファンドの純資産$700,000を加算する。$4,200,000＋$18,000,000－$9,300,000－$120,000＋$450,000＋$700,000＝$13,930,000。$13,230,000は内部サービスファンドの取込みを落とした金額、$14,230,000はプレミアムを無視した金額、$13,480,000は未収税の戻し入れを行っていない金額。

questions.stem: A city's governmental funds report capital outlay expenditures of $5,000,000 for the year. Of that amount, $400,000 represents equipment items that individually fall below the city's $5,000 capitalization threshold and are therefore expensed when acquired. Depreciation expense on governmental capital assets for the year is $2,800,000. What is the combined effect of these items in reconciling the net change in governmental fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An increase of $2,200,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: An increase of $1,800,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: An increase of $4,600,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: A decrease of $2,800,000

questions.explanation: Governmental funds expense all capital outlay as an expenditure, while the government-wide statements capitalize qualifying outlays and expense them over time as depreciation. Only $4,600,000 of the $5,000,000 qualifies for capitalization, because the $400,000 of items below the threshold is expensed in both sets of statements and therefore requires no adjustment. The reconciling adjustment adds back the $4,600,000 capitalized and deducts the $2,800,000 of depreciation, a net increase of $1,800,000. The $2,200,000 figure capitalizes the full $5,000,000 including the items below the threshold. The $4,600,000 figure adds back capitalized outlay without deducting depreciation. The $2,800,000 decrease reflects only depreciation and ignores the capitalization.
questions.explanationJa: 政府ファンドでは資本的支出を全額その期の支出として計上するが、政府全体では要件を満たす支出を資産計上し、減価償却を通じて費用配分する。$5,000,000のうち資産計上の対象となるのは$4,600,000であり、計上基準額未満の$400,000は両方の財務諸表で費用処理されるため調整は不要。調整額は資産計上分$4,600,000を加算し、減価償却費$2,800,000を控除した差引$1,800,000の増加となる。$2,200,000は基準額未満の分まで含めて$5,000,000全額を資産計上した金額。$4,600,000は減価償却の控除を行っていない金額。$2,800,000の減少は減価償却だけを反映し資産計上を無視している。

questions.stem: During the year a city issued $6,000,000 face amount of general obligation bonds at 103, receiving total proceeds of $6,180,000, all of which were recorded in a capital projects fund as an other financing source. The city's debt service fund reported $900,000 of principal retirement expenditures. Amortization of the bond premium for the year was $18,000. What is the combined effect of these items in reconciling the net change in governmental fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A decrease of $5,100,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: A decrease of $5,280,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: A decrease of $5,262,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: A decrease of $6,180,000

questions.explanation: Bond proceeds increase fund balance as an other financing source but create a liability rather than revenue under the accrual basis, so the entire $6,180,000 of proceeds, including the premium, is deducted. Principal retirement reduces fund balance as an expenditure but only reduces a liability under the accrual basis, so the $900,000 is added back. Premium amortization reduces interest expense in the government-wide statements with no effect in the funds, so $18,000 is added. The net adjustment is -$6,180,000 + $900,000 + $18,000 = a $5,262,000 decrease. The $5,280,000 decrease omits the premium amortization. The $5,100,000 decrease deducts only the face amount and ignores the premium received. The $6,180,000 decrease omits the principal repayment add-back.
questions.explanationJa: 債券発行収入はファンドではその他財源として基金残高を増加させるが、発生主義では収益ではなく負債の発生であるため、プレミアムを含む受領額$6,180,000の全額を控除する。元本償還はファンドでは支出として基金残高を減少させるが、発生主義では負債の減少にすぎないため$900,000を加算する。プレミアムの償却は政府全体で支払利息を減額し、ファンドには影響しないため$18,000を加算する。調整額は△$6,180,000＋$900,000＋$18,000＝$5,262,000の減少。$5,280,000の減少はプレミアム償却を落とした金額。$5,100,000の減少は額面のみを控除し受領したプレミアムを無視している。$6,180,000の減少は元本償還の戻し入れを落としている。

questions.stem: A city's governmental funds reported property tax revenue of $9,600,000 for the year. The deferred inflow of resources for property taxes that were levied but not available was $380,000 at the beginning of the year and $510,000 at the end of the year. What amount of property tax revenue should be reported for governmental activities in the government-wide statement of activities?
questions.explanation: Under modified accrual, property taxes are recognized only when measurable and AVAILABLE, so amounts levied but not collectible soon enough are deferred in the funds. The government-wide statements use full accrual, under which an enforceable legal claim triggers revenue regardless of availability. The adjustment is the change in the deferred inflow balance: $510,000 - $380,000 = a $130,000 increase, which is added to fund revenue. Government-wide revenue is $9,600,000 + $130,000 = $9,730,000. The $9,470,000 figure subtracts the change instead of adding it. The $10,110,000 figure adds the entire ending deferred balance rather than the change, double counting the prior year's deferral. The $9,600,000 figure applies the availability criterion to the government-wide statements, where it does not apply.
questions.explanationJa: 修正発生主義では固定資産税は「測定可能かつ利用可能」な範囲でのみ収益認識され、回収が十分に早期でない分はファンドで繰延べられる。政府全体では全部発生主義を用い、法的請求権が生じれば利用可能性に関係なく収益を認識する。調整額は繰延流入残高の変動額$510,000－$380,000＝$130,000の増加で、これをファンド収益に加算する。政府全体の収益は$9,600,000＋$130,000＝$9,730,000。$9,470,000は変動額を加算せず控除した誤り。$10,110,000は変動額ではなく期末残高全額を加算しており、前年度の繰延分を二重計上している。$9,600,000は利用可能性要件を政府全体にも適用した誤り。

questions.stem:
A city reported the following interfund transfers for the year:
General Fund to Capital Projects Fund $600,000
General Fund to Debt Service Fund $1,500,000
General Fund to Water Enterprise Fund $300,000
Water Enterprise Fund to General Fund $50,000
What amount of transfers should be reported in the governmental activities column of the government-wide statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: $2,400,000 of transfers out

choices.label: B
choices.text: $2,350,000 of net transfers out

choices.label: C
choices.text: No transfers, because all interfund transfers are eliminated in the government-wide statements

choices.label: D
choices.text: $250,000 of net transfers out

questions.explanation: Transfers among funds reported in the same column are eliminated, so the $600,000 to the capital projects fund and the $1,500,000 to the debt service fund both vanish because all three funds are governmental. Only transfers between governmental activities and business-type activities survive, and GASB 34 requires that they be reported net for each column: $300,000 out to the enterprise fund less $50,000 in produces net transfers out of $250,000, matched by $250,000 of net transfers in for business-type activities. The $2,400,000 and $2,350,000 amounts fail to eliminate the transfers within governmental activities. Concluding that nothing is reported would eliminate cross-column transfers, which must remain so each column reflects the resources actually available to it.
questions.explanationJa: 同一の列に表示されるファンド間の振替は消去されるため、資本事業ファンドへの$600,000と債務償還ファンドへの$1,500,000は、いずれも3ファンドとも政府ファンドであることから消える。残るのは政府活動と事業型活動の間の振替のみで、GASB 34は各列について純額表示を求める。企業ファンドへの$300,000から受入$50,000を差し引き、政府活動は純額$250,000の振替支出、事業型活動は同額$250,000の振替収入となる。$2,400,000や$2,350,000は政府活動内部の振替を消去していない。何も表示しないとするのは列をまたぐ振替まで消去することになり、各列が実際に利用できる資源を示せなくなる。

questions.stem: A city operates two internal service funds. Fund A provides fleet maintenance almost exclusively to departments reported in governmental funds. Fund B provides customer billing services almost exclusively to the city's water and sewer enterprise funds. How should these two funds be reported in the government-wide financial statements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Both are reported in the governmental activities column, because internal service funds are governmental in nature.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Fund A's assets, liabilities, and operating results are consolidated into governmental activities, and Fund B's are consolidated into business-type activities.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both are reported in a separate internal service activities column between governmental activities and business-type activities.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both are excluded from the government-wide statements because their activity is entirely internal to the primary government.

questions.explanation: Internal service funds are proprietary funds for fund reporting, but in the government-wide statements their balances are folded into the column representing the predominant participants in the fund's activities. Because governmental departments are Fund A's predominant customers, its residual assets and liabilities and its operating results are consolidated into governmental activities; because enterprise funds are Fund B's predominant customers, it is consolidated into business-type activities. The internal charges are eliminated so that expenses are reported only once. GASB 34 permits only three column groupings in the government-wide statements, so no separate internal service column exists, and the funds are not excluded because they hold real assets and liabilities of the primary government.
questions.explanationJa: 内部サービスファンドはファンド報告上はプロプライエタリ・ファンドだが、政府全体の財務諸表では、その活動の主要な利用者がどちらかに応じた列に取り込まれる。ファンドAは政府部局が主要利用者であるため、残余の資産・負債および経営成績は政府活動に統合され、ファンドBは企業ファンドが主要利用者であるため事業型活動に統合される。内部課金は消去され、費用が一度だけ計上されるようにする。GASB 34が認める政府全体の列は3区分のみであり、内部サービス用の独立列は存在しない。また、これらのファンドは基本政府の実在する資産・負債を保有しているため除外もされない。

questions.stem: A city's governmental funds report total expenditures of $30,000,000 for the year, including capital outlay of $4,000,000 and bond principal retirement of $1,200,000. Depreciation expense on governmental capital assets is $2,600,000. The liability for compensated absences increased $180,000 during the year and accrued interest payable increased $90,000. All capital outlay met the capitalization threshold. What amount should be reported as total expenses of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: Convert expenditures to expenses by removing the items that are not expenses under accrual accounting and adding the accrual-basis charges the funds omit. Remove capital outlay of $4,000,000, which becomes an asset, and bond principal retirement of $1,200,000, which reduces a liability. Add depreciation of $2,600,000, the increase in compensated absences of $180,000, and the increase in accrued interest of $90,000, since expenses accrue as incurred rather than when paid from current resources. Total expenses are $30,000,000 - $4,000,000 - $1,200,000 + $2,600,000 + $180,000 + $90,000 = $27,670,000. The $28,870,000 figure leaves principal retirement in expenses. The $27,400,000 figure omits both accrual increases. The $25,070,000 figure omits depreciation.
questions.explanationJa: 支出（expenditures）から費用（expenses）への転換では、発生主義上は費用でない項目を除き、ファンドが計上していない発生主義の費用を加える。資産となる資本的支出$4,000,000と、負債の減少にすぎない元本償還$1,200,000を除く。減価償却費$2,600,000、有給休暇負債の増加$180,000、未払利息の増加$90,000を加える（費用は現年度資源からの支払時点ではなく発生時点で認識するため）。総費用は$30,000,000－$4,000,000－$1,200,000＋$2,600,000＋$180,000＋$90,000＝$27,670,000。$28,870,000は元本償還を費用に残した金額。$27,400,000は2つの発生額の加算を落とした金額。$25,070,000は減価償却費を落とした金額。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Sale of a Capital Asset
questions.stem: A county sold a piece of general government equipment for $320,000 cash. The equipment originally cost $900,000 and had accumulated depreciation of $700,000 at the date of sale. The General Fund recorded the full $320,000 as an other financing source. What reconciling adjustment is required to convert the net change in governmental fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities for this transaction?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A decrease of $320,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: A decrease of $120,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: A decrease of $200,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: An increase of $120,000

questions.explanation: The fund statements report the entire $320,000 of proceeds as an increase in fund balance. Under the accrual basis, only the $120,000 gain affects the change in net position, computed as $320,000 proceeds less the $200,000 carrying amount ($900,000 cost - $700,000 accumulated depreciation). The reconciling adjustment removes the $320,000 of proceeds and adds the $120,000 gain, a net decrease of $200,000, which is exactly the carrying amount of the asset removed from the statement of net position. The $320,000 decrease removes the proceeds without recognizing the gain. The $120,000 increase records the gain without removing the proceeds already in fund balance. The $120,000 decrease has both the sign and the amount wrong, since the gain increases net position.
questions.explanationJa: ファンド財務諸表では売却代金$320,000の全額が基金残高の増加として計上される。発生主義では、純資産の変動に影響するのは売却益$120,000のみで、これは売却代金$320,000から帳簿価額$200,000（取得原価$900,000－減価償却累計額$700,000）を差し引いて求める。調整では売却代金$320,000を除去し売却益$120,000を加えるため、差引$200,000の減少となり、これは純資産計算書から除かれる資産の帳簿価額と一致する。$320,000の減少は売却益の認識を欠く。$120,000の増加は、すでに基金残高に含まれる売却代金を除去していない。$120,000の減少は符号も金額も誤りで、売却益は純資産を増加させる。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the reconciliation between the fund financial statements and the government-wide financial statements is correct under GASB 34?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A reconciliation is required only for the proprietary fund financial statements.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The reconciliation must be presented within management's discussion and analysis.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A reconciliation of the fiduciary fund statements to the government-wide statements is required.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A summary reconciliation must be presented at the bottom of the governmental fund financial statements or in an accompanying schedule.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires two reconciliations for governmental funds: total fund balances to net position of governmental activities, and the net change in fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities. Each may appear at the bottom of the related fund statement or on a separate accompanying page, and when the aggregated adjustments obscure the nature of the individual items, the details must be presented in the notes. No reconciliation of fiduciary fund statements is required because fiduciary activities are excluded from the government-wide statements altogether. Proprietary fund statements already use the accrual basis and the economic resources focus, so they generally tie directly to business-type activities. MD&A is required supplementary information and is not the place for the required reconciliation.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は政府ファンドについて2つの調整表を求める。すなわち、ファンド残高合計から政府活動の純資産への調整と、ファンド残高の純増減から政府活動の純資産変動への調整である。いずれも該当するファンド財務諸表の末尾、または別葉の附属明細表として表示でき、集約された調整額では個々の項目の内容が不明瞭になる場合は注記で内訳を示さなければならない。受託活動は政府全体の財務諸表から除外されるため、受託ファンドの調整表は不要。プロプライエタリ・ファンドはすでに発生主義・経済的資源測定焦点を用いており、通常そのまま事業型活動に対応する。MD&Aは必須補足情報であり、この調整表を掲げる場所ではない。

questions.stem: A city sponsors a single-employer defined benefit pension plan for employees paid from the General Fund. During the year the General Fund reported pension expenditures of $1,500,000 equal to the contributions actually made to the plan. Pension expense measured under GASB 68 for the same period was $2,100,000. What reconciling adjustment is required to convert the net change in governmental fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A decrease of $2,100,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: A decrease of $600,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: An increase of $600,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: A decrease of $3,600,000

questions.explanation: Governmental funds recognize a pension expenditure equal to the amount paid or expected to be liquidated with expendable available resources, which here is the $1,500,000 contribution. The government-wide statements recognize the full GASB 68 pension expense of $2,100,000 and a corresponding increase in the net pension liability. The reconciling adjustment is the $600,000 excess of expense over the amount already recorded in the funds, which decreases the change in net position. Deducting $2,100,000 would double count the contribution already expensed in the funds. An increase of $600,000 reverses the direction; recognizing more expense reduces net position. The $3,600,000 amount improperly adds the two figures together.
questions.explanationJa: 政府ファンドでは、支払額または支出可能な流動資源で決済されると見込まれる額を年金支出として認識し、本問では拠出額$1,500,000がこれにあたる。政府全体ではGASB 68に基づく年金費用$2,100,000の全額と、対応する正味年金負債の増加を認識する。調整額は、すでにファンドで計上済みの額を超える費用$600,000であり、純資産の変動を減少させる。$2,100,000を控除するとファンドで費用計上済みの拠出額を二重に差し引くことになる。$600,000の増加は方向が逆で、費用が増えれば純資産は減少する。$3,600,000は両者を単純に合算した誤り。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Change in Fund Balances to Change in Net Position
questions.stem:
A city reports a net change in total governmental fund balances of $1,150,000. The following relate to the year:
Capital outlay that qualified for capitalization $3,400,000 | Depreciation expense $2,900,000
Proceeds from issuance of general obligation bonds at par $2,500,000 | Bond principal repayments $1,100,000
Deferred inflow for property taxes that were levied but unavailable increased $200,000
Accrued compensated absences liability increased $160,000
Net position of the city's internal service fund, which serves governmental departments, increased $90,000
What is the change in net position of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An increase of $380,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: An increase of $290,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: An increase of $540,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: An increase of $180,000

questions.explanation: Begin with the $1,150,000 net change in fund balances. Add capitalized outlay of $3,400,000 and deduct depreciation of $2,900,000. Deduct the $2,500,000 of bond proceeds, which create a liability rather than revenue, and add back the $1,100,000 of principal repayments, which reduce a liability rather than being an expense. Add $200,000 for the increase in unavailable tax revenue, because full accrual does not apply the availability criterion. Deduct the $160,000 increase in compensated absences, an accrued expense the funds do not record. Add the internal service fund's $90,000 increase, which is consolidated into governmental activities. The total is $1,150,000 + $3,400,000 - $2,900,000 - $2,500,000 + $1,100,000 + $200,000 - $160,000 + $90,000 = $380,000. The $290,000 figure omits the internal service fund. The $540,000 figure omits the compensated absences accrual. The $180,000 figure omits the unavailable tax adjustment.
questions.explanationJa: ファンド残高の純増$1,150,000から出発する。資産計上された資本的支出$3,400,000を加え、減価償却費$2,900,000を控除する。収益ではなく負債の発生である債券発行収入$2,500,000を控除し、費用ではなく負債の減少である元本償還$1,100,000を戻し入れる。全部発生主義では利用可能性要件を適用しないため、未収税に係る繰延流入の増加$200,000を加算する。ファンドが計上しない発生費用である有給休暇負債の増加$160,000を控除する。政府活動に統合される内部サービスファンドの純資産増加$90,000を加える。合計は$1,150,000＋$3,400,000－$2,900,000－$2,500,000＋$1,100,000＋$200,000－$160,000＋$90,000＝$380,000。$290,000は内部サービスファンドを落とした金額、$540,000は有給休暇の発生額を落とした金額、$180,000は未収税の調整を落とした金額。

questions.stem: A city leases office equipment under a contract accounted for as a right-to-use lease under GASB 87. During the year the General Fund reported lease payment expenditures of $260,000, of which $210,000 reduced the lease liability and $50,000 was interest. Amortization expense on the right-to-use asset for the year was $195,000. What is the combined effect of these items in reconciling the net change in governmental fund balances to the change in net position of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An increase of $210,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: An increase of $65,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: An increase of $15,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: A decrease of $195,000

questions.explanation: The General Fund expends the full $260,000 of lease payments. Under accrual accounting only the $50,000 of interest and the $195,000 of amortization are expenses, while the $210,000 principal portion merely reduces the lease liability. The reconciling adjustment adds back the $210,000 principal reduction and deducts the $195,000 of amortization, a net increase of $15,000. Interest requires no adjustment because it is an expense in both sets of statements. The $65,000 increase treats the entire $260,000 payment as a liability reduction, ignoring that interest is already an expense in both. The $210,000 increase omits amortization. The $195,000 decrease omits the principal add-back.
questions.explanationJa: 一般ファンドはリース支払額$260,000の全額を支出として計上する。発生主義で費用となるのは利息$50,000と償却費$195,000のみであり、元本相当額$210,000はリース負債の減少にすぎない。調整では元本減少分$210,000を戻し入れ、償却費$195,000を控除するため、差引$15,000の増加となる。利息は両方の財務諸表で費用であるため調整は不要。$65,000の増加は支払額$260,000の全額を負債の減少として扱い、利息がすでに双方で費用である点を見落としている。$210,000の増加は償却費を落とし、$195,000の減少は元本の戻し入れを落としている。

questions.subtopic: Net Investment in Capital Assets — Computation
questions.stem:
A city's governmental activities column includes the following at year-end:
Capital assets, net of accumulated depreciation $40,000,000 (including right-to-use lease assets)
Bonds payable issued to acquire and construct capital assets, including unamortized premium $22,000,000
Deferred outflow of resources — loss on refunding of the capital-related bonds $500,000
Lease liability related to the right-to-use assets $1,200,000
Unspent proceeds of the capital-related bonds held in a capital projects fund $3,000,000
What amount should be reported as net investment in capital assets?
questions.explanation: Net investment in capital assets equals capital assets net of accumulated depreciation, reduced by the outstanding balances of debt attributable to acquiring, constructing, or improving those assets, and adjusted for deferred outflows and inflows attributable to that debt. Unspent debt proceeds are added back because they have not yet been invested in capital assets; the related debt is in the computation but the corresponding asset is still cash. The calculation is $40,000,000 - $22,000,000 - $1,200,000 + $500,000 + $3,000,000 = $20,300,000. The $17,300,000 figure fails to add back the unspent proceeds. The $19,800,000 figure ignores the deferred outflow on the capital-related refunding. The $21,500,000 figure omits the lease liability, which is capital-related debt because it financed the right-to-use assets.
questions.explanationJa: 資本資産への正味投資額は、減価償却累計額控除後の資本資産から、それらの資産の取得・建設・改良に充てた債務の未償還残高を差し引き、当該債務に関連する繰延流出・流入で調整して求める。未使用の起債収入は、まだ資本資産に投下されていないため加算して戻す（対応する債務は計算に含まれる一方、資産側はまだ現金のままであるため）。計算は$40,000,000－$22,000,000－$1,200,000＋$500,000＋$3,000,000＝$20,300,000。$17,300,000は未使用起債収入の戻し入れを行っていない。$19,800,000は資本関連の借換に係る繰延流出を無視している。$21,500,000はリース負債を落としているが、使用権資産の取得に充てられた以上これも資本関連債務である。

questions.stem:
A city's governmental activities include the following at year-end:
Assets restricted by a federal grantor for a highway project $2,400,000, with $300,000 of accounts payable that must be paid from those restricted assets
Assets restricted by state enabling legislation that dedicates a motor fuel tax to street maintenance $1,600,000
Assets set aside by a city council resolution for future equipment replacement $900,000
Nonexpendable principal of a permanent fund that must be held intact $1,000,000
What amount should be reported as restricted net position?
questions.explanation: Net position is restricted when constraints are imposed externally by creditors, grantors, contributors, or laws of other governments, or imposed by law through constitutional provisions or enabling legislation. Restricted net position is measured net of liabilities payable from the restricted assets. The grantor-restricted highway assets contribute $2,400,000 - $300,000 = $2,100,000; the motor fuel tax assets restricted by enabling legislation add $1,600,000; the permanent fund principal that must be held intact adds $1,000,000, and is reported as the nonexpendable portion of restricted net position. Total restricted net position is $4,700,000. The council resolution is an internal constraint that management can reverse, so the $900,000 stays in unrestricted net position; the $5,600,000 figure wrongly includes it. The $5,000,000 figure fails to deduct the liabilities payable from restricted assets, and the $3,700,000 figure improperly omits the permanent fund principal.
questions.explanationJa: 純資産が「拘束」されるのは、債権者・補助金交付者・寄付者・他の政府の法令によって外部から制約が課される場合、または憲法規定や授権法（enabling legislation）によって法的に課される場合である。拘束純資産は、拘束資産から支払うべき負債を控除した純額で測定する。補助金により拘束された高速道路関連資産は$2,400,000－$300,000＝$2,100,000、授権法により拘束された燃料税資産は$1,600,000、元本維持が求められる永久ファンドの非消費的元本$1,000,000（拘束純資産のうち非消費部分として表示）を加えて、拘束純資産の合計は$4,700,000。市議会決議は経営者が撤回できる内部的制約にすぎないため$900,000は非拘束純資産にとどまり、$5,600,000はこれを誤って含めた金額。$5,000,000は拘束資産から支払う負債を控除しておらず、$3,700,000は永久ファンドの元本を誤って除外している。

questions.stem: A city's governmental activities column reports total assets of $52,000,000, deferred outflows of resources of $1,000,000, total liabilities of $23,000,000, and deferred inflows of resources of $1,500,000. Net investment in capital assets is $19,000,000 and restricted net position is $7,200,000. What amount should be reported as unrestricted net position?
questions.explanation: Total net position equals assets plus deferred outflows less liabilities and deferred inflows: $52,000,000 + $1,000,000 - $23,000,000 - $1,500,000 = $28,500,000. Unrestricted net position is the residual after the other two components: $28,500,000 - $19,000,000 - $7,200,000 = $2,300,000. The $2,800,000 figure ignores both deferred balances. The $3,300,000 figure reverses them, adding the deferred inflow to assets and the deferred outflow to liabilities. The $9,500,000 figure subtracts only net investment in capital assets and leaves restricted net position inside the residual, which would double count those constrained resources.
questions.explanationJa: 純資産合計＝資産＋繰延流出－負債－繰延流入＝$52,000,000＋$1,000,000－$23,000,000－$1,500,000＝$28,500,000。非拘束純資産は他の2区分を差し引いた残余であり、$28,500,000－$19,000,000－$7,200,000＝$2,300,000。$2,800,000は繰延項目を両方とも無視した金額。$3,300,000は繰延流入を資産側、繰延流出を負債側に入れ替えた誤り。$9,500,000は資本資産への正味投資額しか差し引いておらず、拘束純資産を残余に含めたままで、制約のある資源を二重に数えることになる。

questions.stem: Which of the following circumstances results in reporting restricted net position in a city's government-wide statement of net position?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The city council passes a resolution designating $500,000 of resources for future equipment replacement.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Management intends to use $300,000 of available resources to develop a new neighborhood park.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A bond covenant obligates the city to maintain a $750,000 debt service reserve with the trustee.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The General Fund reports $400,000 of assigned fund balance for goods on order at year-end.

questions.explanation: Restricted net position arises only from constraints imposed externally by creditors, grantors, contributors, or laws of other governments, or imposed by law through constitutional provisions or enabling legislation. A bond covenant is a constraint imposed by creditors, so the debt service reserve is restricted. A council resolution and a management intention are internal constraints that the government can modify at will, so those resources remain unrestricted. Assigned fund balance is a fund-level classification under GASB 54 that reflects the government's own intent, and the fund balance categories do not carry over to the government-wide statements, which report only net investment in capital assets, restricted, and unrestricted.
questions.explanationJa: 拘束純資産が生じるのは、債権者・補助金交付者・寄付者・他の政府の法令によって外部から課される制約か、憲法規定・授権法によって法的に課される制約の場合に限られる。債券の財務制限条項は債権者による制約であるため、債務償還準備金は拘束純資産となる。市議会決議や経営者の意図は政府が自由に変更できる内部的制約であり、これらの資源は非拘束のままである。充当済（assigned）基金残高はGASB 54に基づくファンドレベルの区分で政府自身の意図を表すものにすぎず、基金残高の区分は政府全体の財務諸表には持ち込まれない。政府全体では資本資産への正味投資額・拘束・非拘束の3区分のみを表示する。

questions.stem: A county created a legally separate public building authority whose governing board is appointed by the county commission. The authority issued revenue bonds to construct a county office building and leases the building to the county; the debt service on the bonds is expected to be repaid entirely from lease payments made by the county's General Fund. The authority provides no services to any other party. How should the authority be reported in the county's financial statements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Discretely presented in a separate column to the right of the county's total primary government column.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Excluded from the reporting entity and disclosed in the notes as a joint venture.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Reported as a fiduciary activity of the county, because the authority holds the building on the county's behalf.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Blended with the primary government, because the authority's debt is expected to be repaid almost entirely with resources of the county.

questions.explanation: GASB 61 requires blending when any one of several conditions is met, including that the component unit's total debt outstanding is expected to be repaid entirely or almost entirely with resources of the primary government, and separately, that the component unit provides services entirely or almost entirely to the primary government. The building authority satisfies both, so its funds are blended into the county's statements as though they were funds of the county; a blended component unit's general fund is reported as a special revenue fund of the primary government. Discrete presentation is reserved for component units that serve the citizenry rather than the primary government. The authority is controlled by one government, so it is not a joint venture, and it does not hold resources for parties outside the government, so it is not fiduciary.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 61は、複数の要件のいずれかを満たす場合に一体化（blending）を求める。そこには、構成単位の債務残高が基本政府の資源によって全部またはほぼ全部返済されると見込まれる場合や、構成単位が基本政府に対してのみ、またはほぼ専らサービスを提供する場合が含まれる。本問の建設公社は両方を満たすため、その各ファンドは郡自身のファンドであるかのように統合される。なお、一体化される構成単位の一般ファンドは、基本政府の特別収入ファンドとして表示する。区分表示（discrete）は、基本政府ではなく住民にサービスを提供する構成単位に用いる。この公社は単一の政府に支配されているため共同事業体ではなく、政府外部の者のために資源を保有しているわけでもないため受託活動にも該当しない。

questions.stem: Which of the following must a city disclose in the notes to the financial statements regarding capital assets of governmental activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Beginning and end-of-year balances, additions, retirements, and current-period depreciation expense by major class of asset, together with the amounts of depreciation charged to each function in the statement of activities.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Only the net carrying amount of capital assets at year-end, by major class of asset.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Capital assets at historical cost only, with no disclosure of accumulated depreciation or current-period depreciation expense.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Capital asset activity for business-type activities only, because the detail for governmental capital assets is presented in the governmental fund statements.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires a capital asset note that is divided between governmental activities and business-type activities and that presents, by major class, beginning balances, additions, reductions, and ending balances, each shown separately for gross cost and accumulated depreciation. The note must also disclose the amount of depreciation expense charged to each function in the statement of activities. Disclosing only net amounts or only historical cost would omit the roll-forward the standard requires. Governmental capital assets are not reported at all in the governmental fund balance sheet, which uses the current financial resources measurement focus, so the note is required precisely for those assets as well.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、資本資産の注記を政府活動と事業型活動に区分して作成し、主要な資産区分ごとに期首残高・増加・減少・期末残高を、取得原価と減価償却累計額それぞれについて区分表示することを求める。さらに、活動計算書の各機能に賦課された減価償却費の額も開示しなければならない。純額のみ、あるいは取得原価のみの開示では、基準が求める増減明細を欠くことになる。政府の資本資産は流動財務資源測定焦点を用いる政府ファンド貸借対照表には一切計上されないため、まさにこれらの資産についてこそ注記が必要となる。

questions.stem: A city presents a budgetary comparison schedule as required supplementary information for its General Fund. The schedule must include an 'original budget' column. What does the original budget represent?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The budget as legally amended through the end of the fiscal year.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The first complete appropriated budget, adjusted for reserves, transfers, allocations, and supplemental appropriations legally authorized before the beginning of the fiscal year.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The first complete appropriated budget restated to the GAAP basis of accounting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The spending plan proposed by the chief executive before the legislative body acted on it.

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires the budgetary comparison for the General Fund and each major special revenue fund with a legally adopted annual budget to present three columns: the original budget, the final amended budget, and actual amounts on the government's BUDGETARY basis. The original budget is the first complete appropriated budget, adjusted for carryover reserves, transfers, allocations, and any supplemental appropriations legally authorized before the fiscal year begins. The budget as amended through year-end is the final budget column, not the original. Actual amounts must be presented on the budgetary basis, with a reconciliation to GAAP when the two differ, so the columns are not restated to GAAP. An executive's proposed spending plan is not an appropriated budget. A variance column is encouraged but not required.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34は、一般ファンドおよび法的に年次予算を採択した主要な特別収入ファンドについて、予算比較に3つの欄、すなわち当初予算・最終修正予算・予算ベースの実績額を表示することを求める。当初予算とは、最初に成立した完全な歳出予算に、繰越留保・振替・配分、および会計年度開始前に法的に承認された補正予算を反映させたものをいう。年度末までに修正された予算は最終予算欄であって当初予算ではない。実績額は予算ベースで表示し、GAAPと異なる場合は調整表を付すため、各欄をGAAPベースに組み替えることはしない。首長が提案しただけの支出計画は成立した歳出予算ではない。差異欄の表示は推奨であって必須ではない。

questions.stem: A city appoints all five voting members of the board of a legally separate tourism development authority that promotes tourism to the general public. The city cannot impose its will on the authority's day-to-day decisions, but the city is legally obligated to fund any operating deficit of the authority. How should the authority be reported in the city's financial statements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is not a component unit, because the city cannot impose its will on the authority.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is a component unit that is blended with the primary government, because the city appoints the entire board.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It is a component unit that is discretely presented, because the city appoints a voting majority of the board and a financial benefit or burden relationship exists.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is a related organization for which only a note disclosure is required.

questions.explanation: Financial accountability exists when the primary government appoints a voting majority of the organization's governing board AND either can impose its will on the organization OR there is a potential financial benefit to, or financial burden on, the primary government. The appointment plus the city's legal obligation to fund operating deficits satisfies the benefit/burden test even though the city cannot impose its will, so the authority is a component unit. Because the authority serves the general public rather than the city itself and none of the blending conditions is met, it is presented discretely in a separate column. A related organization arises only when the primary government appoints a voting majority but is NOT financially accountable, which is not the case here.
questions.explanationJa: 財務上の責任（financial accountability）は、基本政府が当該組織の議決権の過半数を任命し、かつ、その組織に自らの意思を強制できるか、または基本政府にとって潜在的な財務上の便益もしくは負担が存在する場合に成立する。本問では、全役員の任命に加え、営業赤字を補填する法的義務があるため、意思の強制ができなくても便益・負担要件を満たし、この公社は構成単位となる。公社は市自身ではなく一般市民にサービスを提供しており、一体化の要件をいずれも満たさないため、別列での区分表示となる。関連組織（related organization）とされるのは、議決権の過半数を任命しているが財務上の責任がない場合に限られ、本問は該当しない。
